title: Quad-Lift Fuselage Platform
description: A distributed-lift concept pairing four large rotors with a slender, payload-oriented fuselage. The configuration prioritizes vertical lift, unobstructed body volume, and a straightforward structural path between propulsion arms and the central airframe.
